text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Seeking the Pearl is here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This world is full of possibilities...
I'll prove it by winning races and give hope to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the most gorgeous dream imaginable!
Now! Let's go beyond all possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
